paite: Huchi in huai tengteng ahih khit un huai a Israel mi om tengteng in Judah gam tengteng leh Benjamin gam leh Ephraim leh Manasseh gam suangphuhte ahihzan ua, Asherahte aphuk ua, mun sangte leh maitamte achipsak vek masiah uh Judah gam khuate ah apai zel uhi. Huchi in Israel suante tengteng agam uah amau khua chiat ah apai nawn uhi.
heading: Hezekiah In Sabiak Hinkhua Abawl Thak

paite: Huan Hezekiah in siampute leh Levite apawldan bang zel un michih siampute leh Levite'n atuah chiat ding un, halmang thillat leh lemna thillat lanmi dingte, nasemmi dingte, kipahthu genmi ding leh TOUPA omna kongpi a ngakmi dingte pawl abawlsak chiat hi.
TOUPA dan a tuang bangbang in zingsang lam leh nitaklam halmang thillat dingte, Sabbath leh kha thak leh hunbi nei ankuang a dingte kumpipa tantuan a ding asep hi.
Jerusalem a mipite TOUPA dan a akihihhatna ding un siampute leh Levite tantuan pe ding in thu ape lai hi.
Huai thupiak adalhzaktak in Israel suante'n abuhte, uainte, thaute, khuaizute, alou ua thilsuak masapente ahong pia ua; abangkim uh sawm-a-khat leng ahong pia uhi.
srael suante leh Judah suante, Judah khuate a omte'n abawng uleh belam uh sawm-a-khatte, TOUPA a Pathian uh tantuam dia apiaksawn uh sawm-a-khatte ahon pia ua, akoihkhawm ekok phet uhi.
Kha thumna ah akoihkhawm pan ua, akha sagihna ah akoihkhawm khin uhi.
Huchi in Hezekiah leh amiliante un koihkhawm amuh un TOUPA leh ami Israelte aphat uhi.
Hezekiah in athil koihkhawm tungtang thu uh huai siampute leh Levite adong a.

Zadok mi siampu heutu Azariah in adawng a, "Mite'n TOUPA' inn a thilpiak ahon tawi tung ua kipan in i ne zel ua, i deihkhop ua, a-om ekok lai hi. TOUPA'N mite avualzawl zel a, hiai a om ekok lai teng i kham val uh ei ve," achi hi.
Huchi in Hezekiah in TOUPA' inn ah dantante bawl ding in thu apia a; abawlta uhi.
Huan thilpiakte sawm-a-khatte, Pathian a tuamte muanhuaitak in anawn lut uhi: aheutu uh Levi mi Konaniah ahi a, a-unau Shimei bel azom ahi.
Konaniah leh a-unau Shimei nuai ah kumpipa Hezekiah leh Pathian inn a heutu Azariah seh in endikmi Jehiel, Azajiah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismakiah, Mahath leh Benaiahte a-om uhi.
Levi mi Imna tapa Kore, suahlam kongkhak ngakmi Pathian kiang a lungsim ut thu a thilpiak kempa leh TOUPA a dia thilpiak leh thil siangthoupen hawmpa ahi.
Anuai ah Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, Shekaniah, siampu khua ah nasep hunbi chiat ah a-unaute uh apawlpawl aneu leh aliante kiang a semmi a-om uhi:
Khangthu sut pasal kum thum chiang tunglam, niteng a TOUPA' inn a nasep kul nei a pawl dandan bang ua hohsekte sim louh in.
A-inkuan uh pipute gelhna a siampu asehte leh Levi mi kum sawmnih chiang tunglam apawldan bang zel ua nasemmi dia sehte;
pipute gelhna a tuang ataneute tengteng uh, azite uh, atapate uh, a-inkuan tengteng uh; asepna bik ua siangthoutak a akihihsiangthoute ahi uhi.
Aaron suan kho chih khopua a om siampute leh Levite suante gelhna a tuang peuhmahte tantuan pe ding mi sehtuam a-om uhi.
Huchibang in Judah gam tengteng ah Hezekiah in ahih a, TOUPA a Pathian mitmuh in hoih leh dik leh muanhuai thil ahih sek hi.
Pathian nasep lam thu ah, dan lam thu ah, thupiak lam thu ah, a Pathian zon thu ah ahih peuhmah ah alungsim tengteng in ahih a, alamzang zel hi.
